title: Jesus, Founder and Perfecter of Our Faith

questions.question: Therefore, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of ____, let us also lay aside every weight, and sin which clings so closely...
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:1 (ESV): "Therefore, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us also lay aside every weight, and sin which clings so closely, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us,"

questions.question: ...and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus, the ____ and perfecter of our faith...
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:1-2 (ESV): "...and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus, the founder and perfecter of our faith..."

questions.question: ...who for the ____ that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is seated at the right hand of the throne of God.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:2 (ESV): "...who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is seated at the right hand of the throne of God."

questions.question: Consider him who endured from sinners such hostility against himself, so that you may not grow ____ or fainthearted.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:3 (ESV): "Consider him who endured from sinners such hostility against himself, so that you may not grow weary or fainthearted."

questions.question: In your struggle against sin you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:4 (ESV): "In your struggle against sin you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood."

questions.question: And have you forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons? "My son, do not regard lightly the discipline of the Lord, nor be weary when ____ by him."
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:5 (ESV): "And have you forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons? 'My son, do not regard lightly the discipline of the Lord, nor be weary when reproved by him.'"

questions.question: For the Lord disciplines the one he ____, and chastises every son whom he receives.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:6 (ESV): "For the Lord disciplines the one he loves, and chastises every son whom he receives."

questions.question: It is for discipline that you have to endure. God is treating you as ____. For what son is there whom his father does not discipline?
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:7 (ESV): "It is for discipline that you have to endure. God is treating you as sons. For what son is there whom his father does not discipline?"

questions.question: For the moment all discipline seems painful rather than pleasant, but later it yields the peaceful fruit of ____ to those who have been trained by it.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:11 (ESV): "For the moment all discipline seems painful rather than pleasant, but later it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it."

questions.question: Strive for peace with everyone, and for the ____ without which no one will see the Lord.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:14 (ESV): "Strive for peace with everyone, and for the holiness without which no one will see the Lord."

questions.question: See to it that no one fails to obtain the grace of God; that no "root of ____" springs up and causes trouble, and by it many become defiled;
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:15 (ESV): "See to it that no one fails to obtain the grace of God; that no 'root of bitterness' springs up and causes trouble, and by it many become defiled;"

questions.question: that no one is sexually immoral or unholy like ____, who sold his birthright for a single meal.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:16 (ESV): "that no one is sexually immoral or unholy like Esau, who sold his birthright for a single meal."

questions.question: For you have not come to what may be touched, a blazing fire and darkness and gloom and a tempest... But you have come to Mount ____ and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:18, 22 (ESV): "For you have not come to what may be touched... But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable angels in festal gathering,"

questions.question: and to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:24 (ESV): "and to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel."

questions.question: Therefore let us be grateful for receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, and thus let us offer to God acceptable worship, with reverence and awe, for our God is a consuming ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 12:28-29 (ESV): "Therefore let us be grateful for receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, and thus let us offer to God acceptable worship, with reverence and awe, for our God is a consuming fire."

key_verse_text: Therefore, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us also lay aside every weight, and sin which clings so closely, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus, the founder and perfecter of our faith...
